input.findings: Change fixes a bug in patch_settings: `result[key] = value or current.get(key)` discarded falsy supplied values (None, "", False) and fell back to current. New code `result[key] = value` assigns supplied values unconditionally. Omitted keys never enter the loop (api.py builds patch from present keys only), so they retain current values via dict(current). Four new regression tests cover None, empty string, False, and omitted-key cases. Callers: api.py update_preferences, cli.py clear_note. No security/IO surface; pure dict manipulation.
